nodes.statement:
∀ {K σ : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ]
    (p q a : MvPolynomial σ K) (R S : ℕ),
    p.totalDegree ≤ R → q.totalDegree ≤ R → a.totalDegree ≤ S →
    2 * R + S < Fintype.card σ * (Fintype.card K - 1) →
    (∑ x : σ → K, MvPolynomial.eval x p * MvPolynomial.eval x q * MvPolynomial.eval x a) = 0
nodes.proof_route: Expand each polynomial into monomials. Below d(q-1), every supported exponent vector has one coordinate <q-1. Factor each monomial evaluation sum into a product of coordinate power sums; that coordinate factor is zero. Apply totalDegree_mul twice and the three separate degree bounds.

nodes.statement:
∀ {K σ ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [Fintype ι]
    (p q : MvPolynomial σ K) (forms : ι → MvPolynomial σ K) (values : ι → K) (R : ℕ),
    p.totalDegree ≤ R → q.totalDegree ≤ R → (∀ i, (forms i).totalDegree ≤ 1) →
    2 * R + Fintype.card ι * (Fintype.card K - 1) < Fintype.card σ * (Fintype.card K - 1) →
    (∑ x : σ → K, MvPolynomial.eval x p * MvPolynomial.eval x q *
      MvPolynomial.eval x (ExpandingCodes.flatIndicator forms values)) = 0
nodes.proof_route: Build equationIndicator p a=1-(p-C a)^(q-1), prove its exact 0/1 evaluation by finite-field Fermat, multiply indicators, and bound total degree by card ι*(q-1). Then apply the independently proved triple-polynomial orthogonality theorem. The application ι=Fin 3 gives paper Lemma 2.2 column orthogonality.

    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, ∀ (g : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Geometry (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n)
      (s : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Forms g.F (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.arity ε))
      (h : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Hashes g.F (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.arity ε) (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.buckets ε n)) (x : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Word n),
      ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.testMatrix g ((ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.combined g s h).mulVec x) = 0 ∧
      ∀ e : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Word (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n),
        (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.testMatrix g ((ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.combined g s h).mulVec x + e)).rank ≤ ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.weight e
